# DIASPORA

Public projection of the C.O.R.S.I.C.A. diaspora directory and living book.
Canonical corpus: https://github.com/JeanHuguesRobert/barons-Mariani/tree/main/projects/diaspora
Issue: https://github.com/JeanHuguesRobert/barons-Mariani/issues/96
Public host: https://diaspora.acorsica.org
The public tree is a static release of this projection, not a frozen edition.

Seed: ../data/seed.json
No person records are published.
Suna has no recovered primary source. Do not invent one.
Matching must not treat the holder of a need as the helper.
